drafts.angle: Autonomy loop (rides @rauchg's 'Prompt, spec, exit criteria, desired outcomes. The autonomy loop.', 61K)
drafts.draft_en:
Before you generate the ad, define what it can't say.

Brand rules. Approved claims. Platform policy.

That's the spec. Those are the exit criteria.

Generate → check → fix → ship.

The autonomy loop works for creative too. It just needs a verifier in it.
drafts.video_tip: 15s vertical: type the three rule lines on screen as a 'spec', cut to a real Aubric check returning approve / fix / block, end on the last line. Burn in captions; use only your own ads and real product footage.

drafts.angle: Numbered roadmap (rides @rauchg's '① ② ③ ④ Own your intelligence roadmap' and @gregisenberg's numbered playbooks, 3.5K bookmarks)
drafts.draft_en:
Own your creative risk roadmap:

① Write brand rules as code, not a PDF
② Check every claim against what legal approved
③ Check each ad platform's policy before publish
④ Keep the trace: prompt, model, checks, approver

AI makes the ads now. You still own what they say.
drafts.video_tip: 20s talking head with ①-④ stacking on screen one beat at a time; on ④ show a real Aubric trace view. Hold the last line 2s.

drafts.draft_en:
AI ad factories are so early November.

everyone knows the future is the inspector at the end of the line.
drafts.video_tip: 8s meme cut: fast montage of generated ad variants piling up, freeze, then a single 'APPROVED / BLOCKED' stamp from a real Aubric run. Text overlay is the post itself.
